## Aprisco Urbano - Church Website

A complete, professional website for Aprisco Urbano Church built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and Stripe integration.

### Features Implemented:
- Modern responsive design with mobile-first approach
- Complete authentication system with NextAuth.js
- Admin panel for content management
- Event management with paid/free events
- Stripe payment integration
- Photo gallery system
- Weekly discipleship groups management
- Service times management
- Professional layout with header and footer
- Database with comprehensive schema
- Seed data for testing

### Technology Stack:
- Next.js 14 with App Router
- TypeScript for type safety
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL
- NextAuth.js for authentication
- Stripe for payments
- Heroicons for icons
- Date-fns for date manipulation

### Project Structure:
- Complete page structure (Home, Services, Events, Admin)
- Reusable components
- Database models and relationships
- API routes for functionality
- Authentication and authorization
- Responsive design system

### Ready for Production:
- Environment configuration
- Database migrations and seeding
- Security best practices
- Professional documentation
- Deploy-ready configuration

The project is now ready for customization and deployment.
